about: Wording the doc scans refuse in agent-facing files. tests/test_doc_consistency.py applies each rule to the files in its scope. scripts/append_history.py and scripts/append_rejected.py apply every rule to an entry before they record it, because a recorded entry cannot be reworded. A line that matches `excused_by` is let through.

rules.why: names the product had before v3
`codex_hooks` is the deprecated alias; the flag is `hooks`
the substrate targets 3.11 and later, so a pinned 3.13 is stale

rules.excused_by: (?i)remov|deprecat|no longer|do not source|don't source|history|v3\.2\.1[01]|sourced as shell|was \. \.substrate
rules.why: sourcing the config runs it as shell
